اللَّهُمَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ وَأَحْيِنَا مُسْلِمِينَ وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِينَ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ

O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims, and keep us alive as Muslims, and join us with the righteous — neither humiliated nor afflicted by trial.

“Cause us to die as Muslims” means: I am a Muslim until the end of my life, until the last moment of my life, in submission to You. And “keep us alive as Muslims”: for as long as You allow me to live, allow me to live in a state of submission to You. And then in the Hereafter join me with the righteous, because a person will be with those whom he loves — and join me with them in a state where we have not been humiliated. How is a person humiliated? That they end up disobeying Allah, because of which they will be punished in the next life; and that is the greatest humiliation, that a person is punished on the Day of Judgement. And wa la maftunin — the one who is put in fitnah, in temptation in this world, and fails, and as a result of that is put into the punishment of the Fire. So: allow us to enter Paradise safe and sound; allow us to join the righteous company in Paradise safe and sound.

6. O Turner of the hearts
يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ

O Turner of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion. The du’a the Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam made most frequently, as Umm Salamah reported.

So this should be a du’a that we also make a lot. Make it in your sajdah; make it before the salam, before ending your prayer; make it in witr; make it in the last third of the night. Ya Allah, make my heart firm on Your religion. Don’t let it veer off the right path; don’t let it slacken and weaken and give up and quit. Ya Rabb, keep my heart firm on the straight path — because if the heart is firm, then everything else is fine.

7. Turn our hearts to Your obedience
اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ

O Allah, Director of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience.

Just as Allah changes the direction of the wind, He changes the direction of the heart. So: sarrif qulubana — change the direction of our hearts to Your obedience. The Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam would also make this du’a a lot.

8. Guidance, piety, chastity and sufficiency
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى

O Allah, I ask You for guidance, and piety, and chastity, and sufficiency.

Al-huda — keep me firm on guidance, give me the ability to do what pleases You, increase me in guidance; and recall to mind all of the different types and levels of guidance, because everything is included in that. At-tuqa is piety, taqwa, that a person is able to stay away from sin. Al-‘afaf is chastity — ya Allah, protect me, grant me chastity. And al-ghina is sufficiency: give me sufficient wealth that makes me independent of people; and ghina is also real richness, which is the richness of the heart, satisfaction — that whatever I have I am satisfied with it, that I am not greedy, that I do not become the slave of the dinar and the dirham. Grant me contentment and richness. The Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam said that Allah loves the slave who is pious and free of want, meaning content.

9. Guide me and make me adhere to it
اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي

O Allah, guide me and make me adhere to the straight path.

The Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam taught this du’a to ‘Ali (radiyallahu ‘anhu) and said: when you mention guidance, keep in mind the straight path; and when you mention sadad, keep in mind the straightness of the arrow. Meaning: when you shoot an arrow you want it to reach its target, to hit the mark. Just like that, you ask Allah: ya Allah, make me straight on the right path, that I do the right thing, that I make the right choices, that I use the right words. Allah tells us: say words which are straight, correct. And just like that our actions are in need of sadad, of straightness. If you cook something and you misread a step, you misunderstand it, and of course you don’t follow it — then what happens to the final product? It is not as it was supposed to be. And just like that, if we are praying salah and we don’t pray correctly, then we are missing the mark; our salah is not proper.

10. The du’a he began tahajjud with
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ، اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ، إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ

O Allah, Lord of Jibril and Mika’il and Israfil; Creator of the heavens and the earth; Knower of the seen and the unseen — You judge between Your servants concerning that in which they differ. Guide me, by Your leave, to the truth concerning that in which there is difference; indeed You guide whom You will to a straight path.

The Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam would begin his tahajjud with this du’a, so these days especially, as you are performing qiyam, begin your salah with it. Because sometimes, with so many different opinions, you get confused, you don’t know what is right and what is wrong. So: ya Allah, in all of these differences, guide me to the truth.

11. Adorn our hearts with faith
اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ

O Allah, make faith beloved to us and adorn our hearts with it; and make disbelief, deviance and disobedience hateful to us; and place us among the rightly guided; and make us guides who are themselves rightly guided.

Make us rightly guided, and make us also those who are a means of guidance for others.

12. The du’a for which he said: ask and you shall be given
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ، وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَعْلَى جَنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ

O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not go away, and bliss that does not run out, and the companionship of Muhammad salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam in the highest garden of eternity.

Ibn Mas‘ud (radiyallahu ‘anhu) was once reciting the Qur’an in salah in the masjid, and the Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam heard him making du’a, and he said: ask and you shall be given, ask and you shall be given. And then he said: whoever wishes to learn the Qur’an properly, let him learn as Ibn Umm ‘Abd recites it. So when the companions heard the Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam praising him like this, the next day Abu Bakr (radiyallahu ‘anhu) went to him and asked him: what were you asking Allah for? And he mentioned these words. And it is this du’a for which the Prophet salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam said “ask and you shall be given” — because what was he asking for? Faith that does not go away, which is the best kind of iman, the kind in which there is no doubt. And not just Jannah — such bliss, such blessings and enjoyment that will never run out; because what you have in the world will end, and what is with Allah will remain. And then the companionship of Muhammad salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam in the highest garden of eternity.

Ya muqallib al-qulub, thabbit qalbi ‘ala dinik.
Ameen ya Rabbal ‘alamin.

When life feels constricted

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the constriction of the world and the constriction of the Day of Judgment.

Sunan Abi Dawud 5085
9
The comprehensive du’a at the end of a gathering
اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ، وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ، وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا، وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا، وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا، وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا

O Allah, apportion for us fear of You that shall come between us and disobedience of You; and of obedience to You, that which shall cause us to obtain Your Paradise; and of certainty, that which shall make the afflictions of the world easy for us. And let us enjoy our hearing, our seeing, and our strength as long as You keep us alive, and make it the inheritor of us. And let our vengeance be upon those who have wronged us, and aid us against those who show enmity towards us. And do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world our greatest concern nor the limit of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who will not have mercy on us.

Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 3502

Light on the tongue, heavy in the scale, beloved to Allah

The four phrases Allah answers with “you have spoken the truth”

When you see the good result of your efforts

6

At the beginning of salah

9
The words Abu Dharr reported Allah loves the most

Glory be to Allah who has no partner; to Him belongs the dominion and due to Him is all praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power or might except with Allah. Glory be to Allah and praise is to Him.

10
Taught to a man who asked for a du’a that would benefit him

O Allah, for You is all praise, and all matters return to You.

11
When rising from ruku’

O Allah, our Rabb, for You is praise that would fill the heavens and the earth, and fill that which will please You besides them.

12
Glorifying Allah without limit
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ

Glory be to Allah, as much as the number of His creation. Glory be to Allah, as much as what can fill His creation. Glory be to Allah, as much as the number of what is in the skies and the earth. Glory be to Allah, as much as what can fill the skies and the earth. Glory be to Allah, as much as what can fill His creation. Glory be to Allah, for all that His Book has enumerated. And glory be to Allah, as much as what can fill everything.

Set 4 · Du’as for Knowledge

0 of 6 memorised
1
The du’a Allah taught His Messenger
رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا

My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

2
For ease in learning and in conveying
رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

My Lord, expand for me my chest, and make my task easy for me, and untie the knot from my tongue, so that they may understand my speech.

3
For beneficial knowledge, and refuge from the rest
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ

O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, and I seek refuge with You from knowledge that does not benefit.

4
After the Fajr prayer
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا

O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.

5
To benefit from what you have already learnt
اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا

O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

6
Refuge from four things
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that is not humble, from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.

Set 5 · Du’as for Strength in Faith

0 of 6 memorised
1
The du’a of Yunus (‘alayhis salam)
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

There is no deity except You; glory be to You; indeed I have been of the wrongdoers.

2
Declaring His oneness — a hundred times in the day
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

There is no deity except Allah alone, having no partner; His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He is over all things fully competent.

3

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.

4

اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا

Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate any partner with Him.

5
From the shirk we don’t notice
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know of.

6
Surrender, trust, and return
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي، أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ

O Allah, it is unto You that I surrender myself, and in You I affirm my faith, and upon You I put my trust, and to You I turn in repentance, and with Your help I contend with my adversaries. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your might — there is no god but You — that You send me astray. You are the Ever-Living who does not die, while the jinn and mankind will die.

Set 6 · Du’as for Contentment With His Decree

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the difficulties of severe calamity, from being overtaken by wretchedness, from an evil fate, and from the malicious joy of enemies.

From the du’a of qunut in witr

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the decline of Your blessing, the changing of Your protection, the suddenness of Your punishment, and from all things that cause Your anger.

Set 7 · Du’as for Parents

0 of 4 memorised
1
The du’a Allah commands in Surat al-Isra

My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

The du’a of Nuh (‘alayhis salam)

The du’a of Sulayman (‘alayhis salam)

O Allah, make me among those brought near to You, and make my mother among the beautiful women of Paradise.

The du’a of Ibrahim (‘alayhis salam)

The du’a of Zakariyya (‘alayhis salam)

Set 9 · Du’as for Spouse and Marriage

1
For finding a good spouse — the du’a of Musa

2
Refuge from four things
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَارِ السُّوءِ، وَمِنْ زَوْجٍ تُشَيِّبُنِي قَبْلَ الْمَشِيبِ، وَمِنْ وَلَدٍ يَكُونُ عَلَيَّ رَبًّا، وَمِنْ مَالٍ يَكُونُ عَلَيَّ عَذَابًا، وَمِنْ خَلِيلٍ مَاكِرٍ عَيْنُهُ تَرَانِي وَقَلْبُهُ يَرْعَانِي

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from an evil neighbour, from a spouse who causes me to grow old before old age, from a child who becomes a master over me, from wealth that becomes a punishment for me, and from a cunning friend whose eye watches me and whose heart plots against me.

3
Join our hearts, and mend our relationship
اللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ

O Allah, join our hearts, and mend our relationship, and guide us to the ways of peace, and bring us out of darkness into light, and save us from indecencies, those that are apparent and those that are hidden.

4
Guide me to the best of conduct
وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ

And guide me to the best of manners, for none can guide to the best of them except You; and turn away from me bad manners, for none can turn them away from me except You.

Set 10 · Du’as in Salah

0 of 7 memorised
1
The opening du’a — du’a al-istiftah
سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ غَيْرُكَ

Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours; blessed is Your name, and exalted is Your majesty; and there is no god other than You.

2
Another opening du’a
اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ وَالْبَرَدِ

O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the east from the west. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth. O Allah, wash me of my sins with snow, water, and hail.

3
In ruku‘
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ

Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.

4
On rising from ruku‘
سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ

Allah hears the one who praises Him. Our Lord, and Yours is the praise — abundant, pure, and blessed praise.

5
In sajdah
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى

Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

6
Sitting between the two sajdahs
رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي

My Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, mend me, raise me, provide for me, guide me, and grant me well-being.

7
The tashahhud
التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

All greetings of humility are for Allah, and all prayers and all goodness. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

Set 11 · Adhkar After Salah

0 of 8 memorised
1
First, the takbir — then istighfar three times
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ

Allah is the greatest. I seek forgiveness from Allah, I seek forgiveness from Allah, I seek forgiveness from Allah.

2
O Allah, You are peace
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ

O Allah, You are peace, and from You comes all peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honour.

3
Three times — and none can prevent what He gives
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ

There is no deity except Allah alone, having no partner; His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He is over all things fully competent. O Allah, no one can prevent what You bestow, and no one can bestow what You prevent; and the might of the mighty one cannot help him against You.

4
The longer form — sincerity to Him alone
لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ

There is no might or power except with Allah. There is no deity except Allah, and we worship none but Him. His are all blessings, His is all bounty, and His is the excellent praise. There is no deity except Allah; we devote our worship purely to Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

5
The tasbihat — thirty-three each, on your fingers
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ · الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ · اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

Glory be to Allah; all praise is for Allah; Allah is the greatest — thirty-three times each, or ten times each if you cannot. Then Ayat al-Kursi, and Surat al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas.

6
The du’a he taught Mu‘adh, whom he loved
رَبِّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

O my Lord, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in the best way.

7
Protect me on the Day of Resurrection
رَبِّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ

O my Lord, protect me from Your punishment on the Day when You resurrect Your slaves.

8
After Witr — three times
سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ

Glory be to the King, the Most Pure.

Set 12 · Istikharah, and Asking for What Is Good

0 of 7 memorised
1
The du’a of istikharah — after two rak‘ah
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ

O Allah, I seek Your choice by Your knowledge, and I seek Your decree by Your power, and I ask You of Your great favour. For You decree and I do not, and You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of all unseen matters. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless me in it. And if You know that it is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it; and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and then make me pleased with it.

2
The du’a of Musa (‘alayhis salam) in Madyan
رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ

My Lord, indeed I am in need of whatever good You would send down to me.

3
When you are indecisive
اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي لِأَرْشَدِ أَمْرِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي

O Allah, guide me to the most correct of my affair, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul.

4
All good, known and unknown
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا

O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, that which comes soon and that which comes later, what I know of it and what I do not; and I seek refuge in You from all evil, that which comes soon and that which comes later, what I know of it and what I do not. And I ask You to make every decree You have decreed for me good.

5
In the morning
أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ

We have entered the morning and the dominion has entered the morning belonging to Allah; and all praise is for Allah. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, the good of what is in it and the good of what comes after it; and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day, the evil of what is in it and the evil of what comes after it. (In the evening, say amsayna wa amsa al-mulku lillah and hadhihi al-laylah.)

6
When the wind blows
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ

O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the goodness that is in it, and the goodness that it was sent with; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil that is in it, and the evil that it was sent with.

7
When something new enters your life
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جُبِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جُبِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ

O Allah, I ask You for its goodness and the good it was created with, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil it was created with.

Set 13 · Du’as for Good in Both Homes

0 of 8 memorised
1
The most comprehensive du’a
رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

2
Forgiveness and well-being in every part of life
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي

O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family, and in my wealth.

3
Set right my religion, my world, and my Hereafter
اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ

O Allah, set right for me my religion, which is the safeguard of my affairs; and set right for me the affairs of my world, wherein is my living; and set right for me my Hereafter, on which depends my afterlife; and make my life a source of increase for me in every good, and make my death a source of comfort for me from every evil.

4
The best of what can be asked for
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ، وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ، وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ، وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ، وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ، وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ، وَثَبِّتْنِي، وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي، وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتِي، وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلَاتِي، وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَتِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ

O Allah, I ask You for the best thing that can be asked for, the best du’a, the best success, the best deed, the best reward, the best life and the best death. Make me firm, and make my scales heavy, and make my faith true, and raise my rank, and accept my prayer, and forgive my sin; and I ask You for the highest ranks of Paradise.

5
The keys of goodness, and good endings
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَوَاتِحَ الْخَيْرِ وَخَوَاتِمَهُ، وَجَوَامِعَهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَظَاهِرَهُ وَبَاطِنَهُ، وَالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ

O Allah, I ask You for the openings of goodness and its endings, and all of it — its beginning, its outward and its inward — and the highest ranks of Paradise.

6
Raise my mention, lighten my burden
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْفَعَ ذِكْرِي، وَتَضَعَ وِزْرِي، وَتُصْلِحَ أَمْرِي، وَتُطَهِّرَ قَلْبِي، وَتُحَصِّنَ فَرْجِي، وَتُنَوِّرَ قَلْبِي، وَتَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ

O Allah, I ask You that You raise my mention, and put down my burden, and set right my affair, and purify my heart, and guard my chastity, and put light in my heart, and forgive me my sin; and I ask You for the highest ranks of Paradise.

7
Barakah in my whole being
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُبَارِكَ لِي فِي نَفْسِي، وَفِي سَمْعِي، وَفِي بَصَرِي، وَفِي رُوحِي، وَفِي خَلْقِي، وَفِي خُلُقِي، وَفِي أَهْلِي، وَفِي مَحْيَايَ وَفِي مَمَاتِي، وَفِي عَمَلِي، فَتَقَبَّلْ حَسَنَاتِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ

O Allah, I ask You that You bless me in my own self, and in my hearing, and in my sight, and in my soul, and in my form, and in my character, and in my family, and in my life and my death, and in my deeds; and accept my good deeds; and I ask You for the highest ranks of Paradise.

8
A house near Him in Paradise
رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ

My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise.

Set 14 · Du’as of Gratitude

0 of 10 memorised
1
The du’a of Sulayman (‘alayhis salam)
رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ

My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness of which You approve; and admit me by Your mercy into the ranks of Your righteous servants.

2
The first words of the day
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ

All praise is due to Allah who healed me in my body, and returned to me my soul, and permitted me to remember Him.

3
With every morsel and every sip
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

All praise is for Allah.

4
After eating
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَفَانَا وَأَرْوَانَا غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مَكْفُورٍ

Praise be to Allah who has satisfied our needs and quenched our thirst; Your favour cannot be compensated nor denied.

5
For bread, oil and salt
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَشْبَعَنَا مِنَ الْخُبْزِ بَعْدَ أَنْ كَانَ طَعَامُنَا الْمَاءَ وَالتَّمْرَ

Praise be to Allah who has filled us with bread, after our food had previously been only water and dates.

6
The last words of the day
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَفَانِي وَآوَانِي، وَأَطْعَمَنِي وَسَقَانِي، وَالَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَيَّ فَأَفْضَلَ، وَالَّذِي أَعْطَانِي فَأَجْزَلَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ وَإِلَهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ

Praise be to Allah who has given me sufficiency and has protected me, given me food and drink, been most gracious to me and given to me most lavishly. Praise be to Allah in every circumstance. O Allah, Lord and King of everything, God of everything, I seek refuge in You from the Fire.

7
After salah — for the ability to be grateful
اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in the best manner.

8
When you see people collecting gold and silver
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ، وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ شُكْرَ نِعْمَتِكَ وَحُسْنَ عِبَادَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قَلْبًا سَلِيمًا وَلِسَانًا صَادِقًا، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا تَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ

O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in all my affairs, and determination upon right guidance; and I ask You for the things that bring about Your mercy and the things that necessitate Your forgiveness; and I ask You for gratitude for Your blessing and for excellence in worshipping You; and I ask You for a sound heart and a truthful tongue; and I ask You for the best of what You know, and I seek refuge in You from the worst of what You know, and I seek Your forgiveness for what You know — indeed You are the Knower of all unseen matters.

9
Make us grateful for Your blessings
اللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتْمِمْهَا عَلَيْنَا

O Allah, join our hearts, and mend our relationship, and guide us to the ways of peace, and bring us out of darkness into light, and save us from indecencies, those apparent and those hidden. And bless us in our hearing, our sight, our hearts, our spouses and our children, and accept our repentance — indeed You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Your blessing, praising You for it and accepting it, and complete it for us.

10
Help me, do not help against me
رَبِّ أَعِنِّي وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَيَّ، وَانْصُرْنِي وَلَا تَنْصُرْ عَلَيَّ، وَامْكُرْ لِي وَلَا تَمْكُرْ عَلَيَّ، وَاهْدِنِي وَيَسِّرِ الْهُدَى لِي، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ بَغَى عَلَيَّ، رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي لَكَ شَكَّارًا، لَكَ ذَكَّارًا، لَكَ رَهَّابًا، لَكَ مِطْوَاعًا، لَكَ مُخْبِتًا، إِلَيْكَ أَوَّاهًا مُنِيبًا، رَبِّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتِي، وَاغْسِلْ حَوْبَتِي، وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي، وَثَبِّتْ حُجَّتِي، وَاهْدِ قَلْبِي، وَسَدِّدْ لِسَانِي، وَاسْلُلْ سَخِيمَةَ قَلْبِي

My Lord, help me and do not help against me; grant me victory and do not grant victory over me; plan on my behalf and do not plan against me; guide me and make guidance easy for me; and help me against those who act wrongfully towards me. My Lord, make me greatly grateful to You, greatly mindful of You, much in awe of You, obedient to You, humble before You, and ever turning and returning to You. My Lord, accept my repentance, wash away my sin, respond to my supplication, establish my evidence, guide my heart, make my tongue true, and remove the malice from my heart.

Set 15 · Du’as for Sustenance

0 of 12 memorised
1
The du’a of ‘Isa (‘alayhis salam)
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِنْكَ، وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ

O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table spread with food from the heaven, to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us, and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.

2
The du’a he taught to those who embraced Islam
اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي

O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, give me good health, and provide for me.

3
After Fajr, every morning
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا

O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and deeds that are accepted.

4
Refuge from poverty and humiliation
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, from shortage and from humiliation; and I seek refuge in You from doing wrong to someone, or from becoming the victim of someone else’s wrongdoing.

5
When hunger or thirst wakes you in the night
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ

There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Prevailing; Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the All-Forgiving.

6
Suffice me with the lawful
اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ

O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and make me independent, by Your favour, of all others besides You.

7
From the decline of His blessings
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجْأَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the decline of Your blessing, the changing of the well-being You have given, the suddenness of Your punishment, and from all forms of Your wrath.

8
After eating
اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ

O Allah, bless us in it and feed us better than it.

9
None can restrict what You expand
اللَّهُمَّ لَا قَابِضَ لِمَا بَسَطْتَ، وَلَا بَاسِطَ لِمَا قَبَضْتَ، وَلَا مُقَرِّبَ لِمَا بَاعَدْتَ، وَلَا مُبَاعِدَ لِمَا قَرَّبْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ ابْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَرِزْقِكَ

O Allah, no one can restrict what You have expanded, and no one can expand what You have restricted; no one can bring near what You have put far, and no one can put far what You have brought near; no one can give what You have withheld, and no one can withhold what You have given. O Allah, expand for us of Your blessings and Your mercy and Your favour and Your sustenance.

10
Permanent bliss, and security on the day of poverty
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَقُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَعْطَيْتَنَا وَشَرِّ مَا مَنَعْتَ عَنَّا

O Allah, I ask You for bliss that does not run out, and delight that does not come to an end; and I ask You for contentment after the decree; and I ask You for coolness of life after death. And I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You have given us and from the evil of what You have withheld from us.

11
For the love that is the best provision
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي، وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ فِتْنَةً فِي قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُ إِلَى حُبِّكَ

O Allah, I ask You for the doing of good deeds and the leaving of evil deeds, and the love of the poor; and that You forgive me and have mercy on me. And when You have willed a trial among a people, then take me without my being tried. And I ask You for Your love, and the love of whoever loves You, and the love of the deed that brings one nearer to Your love.

12
When your pockets are empty
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ

O Allah, I ask You of Your favour and Your mercy, for none owns it except You.

Set 16 · Du’as for Fear and Anxiety

0 of 11 memorised
1
Sufficient for us is Allah
حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ

Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

2
Seven times in the morning and the evening
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ

Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

3
When something frightened him
اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا

Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything with Him.

4
The perfect words of Allah
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

5
From anger, from people, from the whispers of devils
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ

I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger, from the evil of His servants, from the evil suggestions of the devils, and from their presence.

6
The du’a Jibril taught him — for fear in the night
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ

I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the upright nor the corrupt can overcome, from the evil of what descends from the sky and of what rises up to it, and from the evil trials of the night and the day, and from the evil of every night visitor — except the night visitor who comes with good, O Most Merciful.

7
You are my strength and my support
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَنَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ

O Allah, You are my strength and You are my support; by You I go forth, by You I advance, and by You I fight.

8
Conceal my faults, calm my fears — morning and evening
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي

O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my right and from my left and from above me; and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being struck down from beneath me.

9
Protect me from going astray
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي، أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ

O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I believe, upon You I rely, to You I turn, and with Your help I contend. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your might — there is no deity but You — that You should let me go astray. You are the Ever-Living who does not die, while the jinn and mankind die.

10
Allah is greater than what I fear
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعًا، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ غَيْرُكَ

Allah is the greatest. Allah is mightier than all of His creation together. Allah is mightier than what I fear and what I am cautious of. I seek refuge in Allah, besides whom there is no deity, the One who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His permission — from the evil of Your slave so-and-so, and his forces, his followers and his supporters, from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my protector against their evil. Great is Your praise, mighty is Your protection, blessed is Your name, and there is no deity but You.

11
Increase in tasbih
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ · سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

Glory be to Allah, and all praise is for Allah, and there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the greatest. Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah, the Most Great.

Set 17 · Du’as for Relief from Worry and Sadness

0 of 12 memorised
1
Busy the tongue with His remembrance
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

Glory be to Allah, and all praise is for Allah, and there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

2
Send salawat on the Prophet
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ

O Allah, send salah upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.

3
The du’a of Yunus (‘alayhis salam)
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed I have been of the wrongdoers.

4
At the time of distress
اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا

Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything with Him.

5
O Ever-Living, O Sustainer
يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ

O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek help.

6
Do not leave me to myself
اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye; and set right for me all of my affairs. There is no deity but You.

7
In times of difficulty
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.

8
Refuge from grief, weakness and laziness
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and from being overpowered by men.

9
O Lord of the people, remove the trouble
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا

O Allah, Lord of the people, remove the trouble; heal, for You are the Healer; there is no healing but Your healing — a healing that leaves behind no illness.

10
Make the Qur’an the spring of my heart
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجِلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي

O Allah, I am Your slave, the son of Your male slave, the son of Your female slave. My forehead is in Your hand; Your judgement upon me is assured, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that You have named Yourself with, or revealed in Your book, or taught to any one of Your creation, or kept with Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen — that You make the Qur’an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, and the banisher of my sadness, and the reliever of my distress.

11
In any distress or sadness
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, the Noble, the Forbearing. Glorified is He, and blessed is Allah, Lord of the Great Throne; and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

12
The du’a on rising from a gathering
اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ، وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ، وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا، وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا، وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا، وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا

O Allah, apportion for us such fear of You as shall come between us and acts of disobedience to You; and such obedience to You as shall cause us to obtain Your Paradise; and such certainty as shall make the afflictions of this world easy for us. And let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our strength for as long as You keep us alive, and make it inherit from us; and let our vengeance be upon those who have wronged us, and aid us against those who show enmity towards us. And do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world our greatest concern nor the limit of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who will not have mercy on us.

Set 18 · Du’as for Firmness on Guidance

0 of 12 memorised
1
In every rak‘ah of every salah
اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ

Guide us to the straight path.

2
Do not let our hearts deviate
رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ

Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy; indeed You are the Bestower.

3
The du’a of Yusuf (‘alayhis salam)
فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ

Creator of the heavens and the earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

4
Pour upon us patience
رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ

Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims.

5
Live us and die us as Muslims
اللَّهُمَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ وَأَحْيِنَا مُسْلِمِينَ وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِينَ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ

O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims, and keep us alive as Muslims, and join us with the righteous — neither humiliated nor afflicted by trial.

6
O Turner of the hearts
يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ

O Turner of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

7
Turn our hearts to Your obedience
اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ

O Allah, Director of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience.

8
Guidance, piety, chastity and sufficiency
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى

O Allah, I ask You for guidance, and piety, and chastity, and sufficiency.

9
Guide me and make me adhere to it
اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي

O Allah, guide me and make me adhere to the straight path.

10
The du’a he began tahajjud with
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ، اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ، إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ

O Allah, Lord of Jibril and Mika’il and Israfil; Creator of the heavens and the earth; Knower of the seen and the unseen — You judge between Your servants concerning that in which they differ. Guide me, by Your leave, to the truth concerning that in which there is difference; indeed You guide whom You will to a straight path.

11
Adorn our hearts with faith
اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ

O Allah, make faith beloved to us and adorn our hearts with it; and make disbelief, deviance and disobedience hateful to us; and place us among the rightly guided; and make us guides who are themselves rightly guided.

12
The du’a for which he said: ask and you shall be given
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ، وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَعْلَى جَنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ

O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not go away, and bliss that does not run out, and the companionship of Muhammad salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam in the highest garden of eternity.
